# All guitar and acoustic-guitar multi-effects — comparison

[Guitar](ALL-GUITAR.md) · [Bass](ALL-BASS.md) · [Vocal](ALL-VOCAL.md) · [Category](MULTI-EFFECTS.md) · [Repository](README.md)

All 325 recorded guitar/acoustic **multi-effects**, including effects-only HX Effects and Cerberus. Amp modeling, an expression pedal and floor operation are not inclusion requirements. Dedicated single-function pedals are in [SINGLE-GUITAR.md](SINGLE-GUITAR.md), outside these tables and active counts.

These are **comparisons of the recorded catalogue**, not exhaustive market coverage or fresh stock certification. Organized 2026-10-16 from the linked source records; their original technical/price dates, firmware, revision and access limits still apply. Every model remains partial. **? means unverified, not No.** Read the complete linked record for sources and conflicting evidence; this view does not silently resolve those conflicts.

K/F/B = independently adjustable rotary controls / footswitches / separate buttons; toe and power switches are additional unless explicitly stated. Body axes and mass qualifications are retained. Color does not prove touch; USB audio does not prove bus power; IRs, native NAM, converted NAM and proprietary captures differ.

Reload/change the model to expose new parameters in existing presets; saved defaults need resaving. Command Center Instant commands gain up to1000ms Wait Time. CC69 snapshot changes received during preset loads are buffered until loading completes. **Shuffling controls (3.80 p.29):** Slices and SeqLen set chop count and sequence length; Shuffle/Pitch/Reverse/Repeat/Drift control random behavior. Smooth softens slice joins; Playback and Low/Hi Cut shape playback. Interval1/2 span −1 to +1 octave. Parameters can be controller-assigned. Press during playback reshuffles; double-press stops while retaining audio; hold during playback or stop deletes it. Shuffle0% with equal Slices/SeqLen isolates pitch/reverse processing. HXE-D p.29 **Global-settings reset preserves presets** (3.80 p.48); this is not evidence that a full factory reset preserves them. Drum machine remains unverified. EXP1 defaults to Wah/Pitch Wham/Poly Wham control and bypass; EXP2 to Volume/Pan control when added through Signal Flow. FS1–6 toggle parameter endpoints; momentary/latching applies per switch, not per assignment. Swapping endpoints reverses control. Reserved global MIDI CCs cannot control parameters. Clear All removes snapshot and default pedal assignments too. Pressing Record/Overdub a second time after initial recording starts playback **with overdubbing active**. The tutorial instead uses Play to end initial recording into playback. These are distinct transitions.<br>**Looper / speed and reverse overdubs:** An overdub recorded at half speed plays at **double speed** after returning to normal, while the original normal-speed track resumes normally. Recording an overdub in Reverse makes that new layer play backward after Reverse is exited; the original resumes its recorded direction. This is not independent track storage.<br>**Memory / scene-folder selection:** Turn Model Select in Scene Select to browse four folders; after changing folders, select a scene within **3 seconds**, otherwise the display returns to the current folder. This is a selection timeout, not evidence that the sound changes merely by browsing. TAP cancels scene selection. [Advanced guide](https://line6.com/data/l/0a0600729af54af8b8963953c/application/pdf/M9%20Advanced%20Guide%20%28Rev%20A%29%20-%20English.pdf)<br>**Memory / scene copy:** Hold **3A + TAP** until Scene Select becomes **Save To**, then choose a destination A/B footswitch. Copying moves the current setup into a scene location; it does not create more than the documented 24 onboard scene memories. TAP cancels from the save screen. QUANTIZE snaps to the nearest beat without that length adjustment;shorterB can repeat withinA. FREE uses independent loop lengths without synchronization. These are timing modes,not additional loop tracks.<br>**Looper / metronome state:** MET MUTE silences the click while retaining tempo/LoopAssist. MET OFF disables those synchronization features. ## Scope and provenance

Instrument views overlap and must not be summed. All 390 active models count once in `research-state.json`; the six explicitly excluded archives never enter these tables. Former/donated eligible devices remain without private receipt/order/payment details. Root brand records take precedence where consolidated; legacy sources remain for full evidence until a checked lossless merge. No GitHub workflow is used.
